description: Items 301–600 from UNSOURCED lists described as extracted from BNF Children 2023 / ICU Quick Drug Guide 2025. Fixed doses are labelled 'Adult / age not stated'; weight-based doses 'Age not stated'. Doses that appear incorrect are NOT loaded. All notes unverified.
